heading: Tomorrow · Sibetan Village Cycling & Cultural Stops
meet_location: Depart from hotel (exact meeting point not specified by Panji)
activities: 7:30 AM · Depart for Sibetan Village cycling excursion.
9:45 AM · Arrive at starting point, enjoy a welcome drink and walk through a salak (snake fruit) plantation.

Cycling route · 12 km, approximately 1.5 hours, mostly downhill with a little climbing. Approximately 80% quiet paved village roads and 20% single-track paths through rice fields, including some narrow or unpaved sections.
Finish cycling with fresh young coconut, then drive back to the start point for lunch.
Traditional lunch · Rice; herb chicken in banana leaves; minced chicken on bamboo skewers; chicken with tomato sauce; young bamboo shoots in coconut milk.
After lunch · Visit Kusamba traditional salt making and Goa Lawah (Bat Cave Temple) on the return journey.
